title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in the development and health of both mother and baby. During pregnancy, the body requires adequate nutrients to support the growth of the fetus and the health of the mother.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are good for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which helps support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, which helps support the development of the fetus's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in iron, which helps support the production of red blood cells and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which help support the development of the fetus's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, which helps support the growth and development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, which help support the immune system and reduce the risk of disease.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To build a balanced plate for pregnancy, you can combine these international pantry staples with other nutrient-dense foods. For example:
- Breakfast: oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: a salad with leafy greens, lentils, eggs, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: a soup with leafy greens, lentils, and chicken.

## Food Safety Considerations
When preparing food for pregnancy, it's essential to consider food safety to reduce the risk of foodborne illness. Some key considerations include:
- Washing your hands before handling food.
- Washing fruits and vegetables before consuming them.
- Cooking food to the recommended internal temperature.
- Avoiding foods that are past their expiration date or have been contaminated.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a critical aspect of a healthy pregnancy. By incorporating international pantry staples into your diet, you can build balanced plates that support the growth and development of your baby. Remember to prioritize food safety to reduce the risk of foodborne illness. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and delicious recipes, visit our [pregnancy meal planner](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner) page.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition, consult with your healthcare provider or a registered dietitian. They can provide personalized guidance and support to help you develop a healthy pregnancy nutrition plan.
